top_creatures.label: Three-step creature line
top_creatures.why: Each line has an A, B and C id and the tier letter is data
top_creatures.keep: tier letter as data; one ladder per line
top_creatures.change: our own names and silhouettes; each tier adds exactly one ability

top_creatures.label: Breaks off at low health
top_creatures.why: Normal temperament breaks at 20 percent health, aggressive at 10 percent
top_creatures.change: break off to a rally point and return after healing; our own thresholds

top_creatures.label: Holds ground
top_creatures.why: A stationary unit cannot run, so the flee branch stands it still
top_creatures.keep: a movement class that overrides flee
top_creatures.change: guard stance with a visible plant animation

top_creatures.label: Calls reinforcements
top_creatures.why: Summon is a special ability on one creature (behaviour not read)
top_creatures.change: summons capped by the zone encounter count (row 23)

top_creatures.label: Bursts on death
top_creatures.why: Explode is a special ability (behaviour not read)
top_creatures.change: short radius, readable flash, no friendly fire

top_creatures.label: Volley shooter
top_creatures.why: Multi-shot is a special ability (behaviour not read)
top_creatures.change: volley of three from a fixed angle fan

top_creatures.label: Status shooter with three severities
top_creatures.why: Poison and disease come in weak, medium and severe steps
top_creatures.keep: one status family in three steps
top_creatures.change: our own status names and durations, shown as a coloured halo

top_creatures.label: Elemental bolt caster
top_creatures.why: Each element has its own bolt projectile
top_creatures.change: our own five elements; bolt colours readable at 375 wide

looks.label: Three-band fog
looks.technique: density ramps weak to strong across one band, then to a clip distance where alpha reaches zero

looks.label: Billboards fade to fog colour
looks.technique: mix toward the fog colour with fog alpha

looks.label: Decal alpha cut
looks.technique: fog is skipped where decal alpha is below 0.004, so transparent texels do not bleed

looks.label: Point light falloff
looks.technique: attenuation 1 minus squared distance over squared radius, clamped; no ambient term when facing away

looks.label: Per-monster tint and sprite set
looks.technique: tint colour per monster descriptor and one sprite name per animation state

looks.label: Blood as a decal
looks.technique: decal pass with vertex colour and alpha; blood-splat-on-death flag per monster

originals.name: Tiered Ambush Line
originals.idea: A creature family in three steps where the tier letter is data and each step adds one ability.
originals.keep: A, B and C tier ladder (MonsterEnums.h:421)
originals.change: our own names, silhouettes and one ability per step; ties to row 7

originals.name: Courage Break
originals.idea: A creature that breaks off at a low-health threshold to a rally point and returns after healing.
originals.change: our own numbers; break-off uses the leash (row 4)

originals.name: Opening Tide
originals.idea: A three-speed roll decides who strikes first in an opening exchange, and a tie goes to the player.
originals.keep: roll of 1, 3 or 5 plus a base, and the tie rule (TurnEngine.cpp:166-172)
originals.change: our own speed values in milliseconds; for a real-time duel, not a turn queue

originals.name: Zone Encounter Card
originals.idea: Each zone row holds three groups with chance, monster, count range and a difficulty gate, plus an alert counter that raises the chance after a fight.
originals.change: our own numbers and the alert counter; ties to row 23

originals.name: Hate Grid
originals.idea: A small aggro grid between creature groups, default friendly, five steps of range.
originals.keep: default friendly and five steps (HostilityTable.cpp:14-22; MonsterEnums.h:493-498)
originals.change: fewer groups; the grid feeds the engine hate list and MAX_ATTACKERS stays at 3
